description: `RELEASE_V1_6_FEATURE_FLAG = 'release-v1-6-feature'` is exported from packages/core/src/lib/features.ts
`TIER_FEATURES.PBX_TELEPHONY` exists with FEATURE_MINIMUM_TIER 'pro'
AccountManagement.tsx label map carries PBX_TELEPHONY with an i18n key
TEAMS_INTEGRATION is removed from ADD_ON_ONLY_FEATURES so tierHasFeature answers by tier for it
getTelephonyProviderAvailability(provider, ctx) in telephonyAvailability.ts returns the base getTelephonyAvailability result unchanged when that is disabled
For '3cx' the helper resolves the tenant tier with resolveTenantTier and returns reason 'tier_required' when PBX_TELEPHONY is not in the tier
For 'teams-phone' the helper adds no checks beyond the base availability
The helper never calls isFeatureFlagEnabled; the flag is read only by the settings card
TELEPHONY_AVAILABILITY_MESSAGES and TelephonyAvailabilityDisabledReason gain 'tier_required'
TELEPHONY_PROVIDERS is ['teams-phone', '3cx'] and TelephonyProviderKind follows
packages/integrations/src/lib/telephony/providerRegistry.ts exports entries with id, labelKey, descriptionKey, requiresTierFeature, releaseFlag and loadEe
The registry lists teams-phone (no tier feature, no flag) and 3cx (PBX_TELEPHONY, RELEASE_V1_6_FEATURE_FLAG)
getTelephonyOverview returns one TelephonyProviderCard per registry entry with a providerAvailability field from the helper
setTelephonyProviderEnabled dispatches to the registry entry's EE module instead of calling the Teams module directly
setTelephonyAutoCreateTickets dispatches through the registry entry
TelephonyIntegrationSettings.tsx renders one card per overview entry using the registry's i18n keys; the hard-coded PROVIDER_LABELS map is gone
The Teams Phone card keeps its prerequisite notice, toggles and copy exactly as before the refactor
ee/packages/threecx exists as @alga-psa/ee-threecx with a lib entry exporting the provider-state functions, renderThreecxTemplate, the route handlers and the route constants
server/next.config.mjs aliases @alga-psa/ee-threecx and @alga-psa/ee-threecx/ to the package on EE and to packages/ee/src on CE
server/tsconfig.json paths carry the same alias pair for @alga-psa/ee-threecx and @alga-psa/ee-threecx/*
The registry's loadEe for 3cx is import('@alga-psa/ee-threecx/lib') and is typed against the package's lib module
A CE typecheck and build pass with @alga-psa/ee-threecx aliased to the stub package
getThreecxProviderState returns status, autoCreateTickets, keyLastFour, keyRotatedAt and templateVersion for the tenant's 3cx row, with status 'not_configured' when no row exists
activateThreecxProvider upserts the 3cx row with status 'active' and generates a 32-byte base64url key when webhook_secret is null
Activation returns the full key only on the call that generated it; later calls return null for the key
deactivateThreecxProvider sets status 'disabled' and leaves webhook_secret in place
rotateThreecxApiKey writes a new key and config.keyRotatedAt and returns the full new key
The 3cx row's config is validated as { templateVersion: number, keyRotatedAt: string | null } on read and write
setThreecxAutoCreateTickets updates auto_create_tickets on the 3cx row
One constants module defines the four route segments and the query parameter names, imported by the routes, the template renderer, the validator test and the emulator

Route files exist under server/src/app/api/telephony/3cx/[tenantSlug]/ for lookup, lookup-by-email, search and report-call, each guarded with isEnterpriseEdition from _ceStub.ts and delegating to the EE package
On CE every 3CX route answers 501 through eeUnavailable()
OPTIONS on every 3CX route answers 204 with an Allow header through telephonyOptionsResponse
An unknown tenant slug answers 404 { error: 'unknown_tenant' } before any key comparison
The inbound-webhook rate limit from rateLimitConfig.ts applies to every 3CX route
The Authorization: Bearer header is verified with verifyBearer against the 3cx row's webhook_secret; a missing or wrong key answers 403 { error: 'forbidden' }
A disabled getTelephonyProviderAvailability result (edition or tier) answers 403
A 3cx row whose status is not 'active' answers 403
Missing or invalid parameters answer 400 { error: 'invalid_request' }
lookup normalizes the number query with normalizeToE164 using resolveTenantPhoneCountryCode before matching
A matched contact returns one Contact whose contactUrl is <baseUrl>/msp/contacts/<contact_id>
A client-only match returns one Contact with companyName set and contactUrl <baseUrl>/msp/clients/<client_id>
An ambiguous match returns every candidate as a Contact
An unmatched number returns { contacts: [] } with status 200
Every Contact returned by lookup carries the number query value verbatim in phone
lookup-by-email matches contacts.email case-insensitively within the tenant
search matches first name, last name, company name, email and normalized phone digits by case-insensitive substring, ordered by name, at most 20 results
lookup, lookup-by-email and search exclude inactive contacts
For lookup-by-email and search, phone is the contact's primary number in E.164
report-call validates the body: callType in the four values, ISO 8601 UTC times, non-negative durationSeconds, optional establishedTimeUtc and queueExtension
callType maps Inbound to inbound, Outbound to outbound, Missed and Notanswered to missed
The number lands on callerNumber for inbound and missed and on calleeNumber for outbound, as { raw, e164 }
providerCallId is the SHA-256 hex of agentEmail lower-cased, the E.164 or raw number, callType and startTimeUtc joined with '|'
organizerUserId is the tenant user whose email equals agentEmail case-insensitively, or null when none matches
startedAt, endedAt and durationSeconds come from the body, durationSeconds is 0 for missed, modality is 'audio' and raw is the full body
report-call enqueues process-telephony-canonical-call with { tenantId, record } and answers 202 { accepted: true, providerCallId } without other database writes
process-telephony-canonical-call is registered in registerAllHandlers.ts beside process-telephony-call-notification with maxAttempts 3 and the same edition gate
The handler runs ingestCanonicalCall for the record and then the shared post-ingest tail
The auto-ticket and notification tail after ingestion is one function called by both the Teams handler and the canonical-call handler
A second report-call with the same hash inputs creates no new ledger row or interaction
renderThreecxTemplate({ baseUrl, tenantSlug, templateVersion, country }) returns XML with Name 'AlgaPSA', the Version, the Country, an ApiKey password parameter and Plus prefix handling
The template carries four scenarios: lookup by number with an empty Id, LookupByEmail, SearchContacts and ReportCall
Every scenario request sends Authorization: Bearer [ApiKey]
Every scenario URL is built from baseUrl, the tenant slug and the route constants
Lookup outputs map contactUrl to ContactUrl, firstName, lastName, companyName, email, and phone to PhoneBusiness
A download action streams the rendered XML as algapsa-3cx-<tenantSlug>.xml and requires canManageTelephony
Downloading stamps config.templateVersion with the renderer's current version
The 3CX card is hidden when useFeatureFlag(entry.releaseFlag) is false
The 3CX card is hidden when useTier().hasFeature(PBX_TELEPHONY) is false
On CE the telephony section shows TelephonyUnavailableCard and no 3CX card
The card shows status, Enable toggle, Auto-create tickets toggle, endpoint base URL with copy, masked key (last four) with Rotate, and Download template
After Enable generates a key or Rotate replaces it, the full key is shown once with a copy button and a not-shown-again warning
Every interactive element on the card carries a kebab-case id
Without canManageTelephony the toggles, Rotate and Download are disabled and the permission message shows
packages/emulators/threecx exists with id 'threecx' on port 4070, registered in suite/src/index.ts, the PACKAGES list in build-image.sh, compose.yml and the README
Action crm-configure { baseUrl, tenantSlug, apiKey } stores the target
Action crm-inbound-call { number, agentEmail, agentExtension, answered, durationSeconds } performs GET lookup then POST report-call with the bearer header and records both exchanges
Action crm-outbound-call performs the same pair with callType Outbound
Action crm-search { q } performs GET search and records the exchange
State view exchanges lists request and response pairs with status codes
The emulator builds its URLs and query parameters from the shared route constants
All card, availability and download strings exist under integrations.telephony.providers.threecx.* in the en locale
The same keys exist in all ten files under server/public/locales/*/msp/integrations.json
The tier_required availability message and the PBX_TELEPHONY tier label are translated in every locale
Existing telephony, Teams Phone and integrations settings tests pass unchanged
The unit suite and the telephony integration tests are green on EE and the CE typecheck is green
